thread:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: coordinated release in 25m for cross-service changes. Window 2026-03-21 02:10-03:10 UTC. Components: API -> v3.4.1, runtime -> v2.9.2, console -> v1.15.1-beta, router -> v4.0.1. Pin plan: runtime pinned for initial 12m then gradual unpin. Canary routing: header-split then progressive ramp. Rollback steps in the runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-21-crosscutover
anya: acked. I'll own console canary and metrics. Putting quicklinks on dashboard for per-route p50/p95, errors, and model mismatch logs.
raf: noted. Added KV warmup + encoder-check step to preflight. Command: `tools/kv-warmup --routes api,router --parallel 6`. Recommend running 2min before first traffic ramp.
li: router plan: start header-split 8% at 02:13, 40% at 02:26, 100% at 02:45 if green. Monitors: 5xx rate, request latency, header mismatch count. Will tag dedicated-customer routes to exclude them from ramp.
sre-oncall: oncall present. Abort criteria: p95 > 420ms for 90s OR 5xx > 0.6% for 60s triggers immediate abort. We will post to #incidents and start rollback. Is deploy-bot configured for these thresholds?
deploy-bot: yes, auto-abort configured with the above thresholds for this deployment id 1711098765. Manual abort: `deploy-bot abort 1711098765` or via console rollback.
anya: console feature flag `enableNewMetrics` should remain off until router at >=40%. I'll hold the flip until li confirms.
li: confirmed, hold flag. Router will include a header `x-release-canary: v20260321` during canary so console can filter.
raf: adding eviction: schedule KV flush at 02:25 UTC (before runtime unpin). Also adding encoder compatibility probe at 02:22.
devex-bot: preflight results: API lint ok, infra checks ok, pinned variants verified. Missing: one integration test failing for api-internal auth. Owner pinged.
anya: integration test owner responded, will patch in 10m. Can we proceed with a partial preflight ok?
sre-oncall: we can proceed if test isn't blocking critical path and owner signs off in thread. Otherwise hold.
raf: rollback snippet for quick ops:
```
# revert runtime image
kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=runtime:v2.9.1 -n inference
# rollback API pin
./deploy/pin-version api v3.3.8
# clear console canary
kubectl rollout undo deployment/console -n platform
```
li: will publish router traffic slices and tag the canary session in tracing.
deploy-bot: final checklist: 1) preflight green OR owner signoff 2) pinned variants validated 3) monitors wired and thresholds set 4) KV flush timed 5) oncall confirmed. React with :rocket: when teams are GO.
